profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at RSA
profile.summary:
An embedded software engineer with solid experience in many areas with an emphasis on communication protocols, network management, safety-critical, real-time, multi-threaded, and embedded software. Strong design, development, debug, and specification writing skills to meet aggressive schedules with quality. MS in Computer Science. Active secret clearance. Fast learner with wide variety of experience. Team player and self-starter.

Specialties: - ARINC 429 Data Link Layer 2 protocols 
- TCP/IP, UDP/IP sockets.
- 10+ years real-time embedded software development with VxWorks, Linux, MicroC/OS-II (protocols, APIs, driver interfaces, bootstrap firmware, power-on diagnostics)
- Embedded Linux, real-time Layer 1 Device Manager
- Embedded network management for a core router including SNMP V1/V2c Agent, MIBs, Layer 1 fault management, driver configuration, router/switch configuration, central office alarms

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Specify, design, develop, test, and debug communications software for aircraft with MicroC/OS-II as the RTOS. Multi-board system with Pentium M motherboard and PPC405GPr processors communicating by generating PCI interrupts and reading/writing to shared memory. Designed Layer 2 protocol finite state machines from ambiguous ARINC 739A-1 Standard and ARINC 619-2 Standard using SDL for visual representation. Implemented protocols in C/MicroC/OS-II as event driven, real-time finite state machines with queues, events, flags.
- Specify, design, develop, test, and debug ARINC Broadcast Data Capture and watchdog timer module.
- Wrote Wingspeed Software Requirements Standard following guidelines in DO-178B
- Specified, designed, implemented, and tested error logging subsystem in C/MicroC/OS-II
- Specified, designed, implemented in C++, and tested Windows XP Logging Service
- Implemented Windows XP console test application to initialize PCI interrupts and read counters in PCI shared memory using Jungo Windriver API software

positions.title: Consulting Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Specify, design, develop, test, and debug embedded antenna control subsystem Multi-Task software for a radar system for 3-D imaging for space surveillance. Controlled and monitored 4 antennas remotely using TCP/IP and UDP/IP sockets with proprietary protocols in C with VxWorks as the RTOS. 
- Designed common interfaces and common data structures to control/monitor any number/type of antenna.
- Design, development, and testing of antenna simulation software in Python to test the antenna control subsystem library software.
- Created and administered CVS repository

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Specify, design, develop, test, and debug of Windows client/server Port Blocker multi-threaded application in C/C++/ACE to disable access to configured devices. Designed and implemented protocol to manage clients' device information in Server's Access database using UDP/IP sockets. 
- Specified, designed, implemented, tested and debugged Database Manager APIs to retrieve and modify device configuration as well as Virtual Disk and client properties in Server's Database.

positions.title: Consulting Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
- This project was cancelled by NASA. Specify, design, develop, test, and debug embedded command and telemetry software for a Mars Laser Communication project in C with VxWorks as the RTOS. 
- Created telemetry data packet formats and selected optical and 1553 packet rates based on internal sample rates of hardware.
- Message queues used for IPC

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Specification, design, development and testing of a Layer 1 Embedded Linux Multi-Threaded Device Manager in C for edge aggregation switches. Delivered on time and with quality on a very aggressive schedule.
- Device Manager configured all layer 1 interfaces, DS3/DS1/DS0 bundles, TDM channels in FPGAs, Agere TSI, Agere UltraFramer chip, BITS clock, loopbacks, and BER tests.
- Dual processor architecture with a PowerPC 8260 and IXP 1200 network processor communicating over an internal Ethernet.
- Designed, implemented, tested, and debugged Unix Local Socket based API to the CLI and SNMP to provide Layer 1 performance data and status.
- Designed, implemented, tested, and debugged DS3/DS1 and Gigabit Ethernet loopback tests as a Power-On Self Test.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Specify, design, develop, debug and test embedded SNMP V1/V2c agent Multi-Task software in C/VxWorks for a Terabit Switch Core Router.
- Team leader/individual contributor for QoS MIB. Wrote QoS MIB and software design specifications. Used RPC and UDP/IP sockets for IPC between tasks and boards.
- Team leader/individual contributor for central office alarms. Specified, designed, implemented, tested, and debugged central office alarm task, protocol, API, and MIB objects.
- Wrote proprietary MIBs and implemented, tested, and debugged SNMP embedded agent code for them.
- Team leader/individual contributor for SNMP agent implementation for Multicast, PIM, BGP, OSPF, and IF MIBs and proprietary MIBs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Specify, design, develop, debug, and test Windows software (applications, file system filter drivers, and dlls).

positions.title: Senior Software/Diagnostics Engineer
positions.description: Specify, design, develop and test bootstrap firmware, power-on diagnostics, and burn-in test monitor.
